meta.title: Start an AI project with TenthMatrix
meta.description: Tell us about the AI agent or generative AI application you want built. An engineer reads every message and replies within one working day.

title: Start a project
lede: Tell us what you want built: an agent, a generative AI application, an integration, or a pilot that needs finishing. An engineer reads every message and replies within one working day.
projectTypes: Generative AI application (knowledge assistant, drafting, copilot)
Review or rescue of an existing AI project
Embedded engineers or a dedicated team
messageHint: The job, the systems it touches, who checks the result and any deadline. A few sentences is plenty.
steps: An engineer reads your message. Not a salesperson.
We reply with questions or a 30-minute call slot.
You get a written scope: what we would build, what it must not do, how we'll measure it and a fixed quote for the pilot.
modelsTitle: Not sure how you want to work?
modelsBody: Fixed-scope project, dedicated agent team, embedded engineers or build-operate-transfer. We'll suggest one once we understand the job.
